integrity: Mathematical proof given using standard ramification and Cartier formulas plus the cited degree-three rational-subfield uniqueness theorem; 36 prime-field checks are supplemental, not a general proof.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed characteristic three, smooth Artin--Schreier genus-five curves of 3-rank two only; general Ekedahl--Oort and Newton polygons are not classified. Independent scholarly priority and validation remain unperformed.
title: The Cartier jump and minimal automorphisms of characteristic-three genus-five Artin--Schreier curves
